classes.name: Topical corticosteroids
classes.description: Topical corticosteroids by potency: hydrocortisone, triamcinolone, fluocinolone, mometasone, betamethasone, fluocinonide, clobetasol, halobetasol, desoximetasone (creams, ointments, lotions, foams, solutions).
classes.plainDescription: A steroid cream or ointment for eczema, psoriasis or rashes.

classes.name: Non-steroid topicals for eczema
classes.description: Topical calcineurin inhibitors (tacrolimus ointment, pimecrolimus/Elidel), PDE4 (crisaborole/Eucrisa, roflumilast/Zoryve), JAK cream (ruxolitinib/Opzelura), tapinarof (Vtama).
classes.plainDescription: A non-steroid cream for eczema, often for the face or long-term use.

classes.name: Topical acne treatments
classes.description: Topical retinoids (tretinoin, adapalene, tazarotene, trifarotene), clindamycin and benzoyl peroxide combinations, clascoterone (Winlevi), azelaic acid, dapsone gel.
classes.plainDescription: A gel or cream for acne.

classes.name: Systemic treatment for moderate-to-severe eczema
classes.description: Biologics and JAK inhibitors for atopic dermatitis: dupilumab (Dupixent), tralokinumab (Adbry), lebrikizumab (Ebglyss), nemolizumab (Nemluvio), abrocitinib (Cibinqo), upadacitinib (Rinvoq) for AD.
classes.plainDescription: A shot or pill for eczema that creams have not controlled.

Pimecrolimus generic is PA; Elidel brand is absent from the 07/01/2026 tool (it appears in the 04/01/2026 thera doc, which the newer tool supersedes). Eucrisa is preferred with clinical criteria. preferredAgent.plainSig: A thin layer on the skin once each evening; not for use in pregnancy.

records.verificationNote: Only tazarotene is listed for acne-type topicals: generic tazarotene is Preferred Generic with no PA on p.26 (indication not printed). Tretinoin, adapalene, trifarotene, clindamycin/benzoyl peroxide, clascoterone (Winlevi), azelaic acid and topical dapsone are absent from both Alabama documents (p.24 lists clindamycin only as vaginal). Not a PDL class for those; coverage unverified, so no alternatives or PA items are claimed. Tazarotene chosen as the only documented no-PA acne retinoid, not as the most commonly written acne topical.

Dupixent is the most commonly written AD biologic and every AD systemic option on the list needs PA, so it is the lowest-barrier pick. Adbry (tralokinumab), Ebglyss (lebrikizumab), Nemluvio (nemolizumab) and Cibinqo (abrocitinib) do not appear on this list; not called nonformulary. Sig is standard label dosing, not printed. Effective date 2026-01-20 matches the printed update date (record A uses the same).]
